When strategy is <code>PARTITION</code>, <code>partitionCount</code> must be set. This field cannot be modified after creation.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

## Import



Placement group can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Placement/group:Group foo ps-ilan8vjf
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
